description: Estimate what I bonds are worth for an issue month and purchase amount at the start of a month: value with all interest and the redemption value after the 3-month penalty for bonds under 5 years. Uses semiannual compounding per $25 with the TreasuryDirect rates. An estimate; Treasury values can differ by cents.

amount.description: Purchase price in dollars, for example 10000.

as_of_month.description: Month to evaluate, YYYY-MM. Default: the current month.

issue_month.description: Issue month of the bond as YYYY-MM, for example "2023-01". The issue date is the first of the month you bought it.

name: estimate_i_bond_value
title: Estimate I bond value
